description: This bar chart, titled “Strong Supervision” and “Weak Supervision” in its legend, illustrates the performance gain in percentage for three different large language models—GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL—under two distinct supervision conditions. The vertical y-axis, labeled “Performance Gain (%)”, is scaled linearly from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal x-axis lists the three model names in alphabetical order. For each model, two bars are displayed side-by-side: the left bar, colored with diagonal stripes and labeled “Strong Supervision,” and the right bar, solid blue and labeled “Weak Supervision.” For GPT-4o, the strong supervision bar reaches approximately 24.5%, while the weak supervision bar is at about 5.5%. For Claude-3.5-Sonnet, the strong supervision bar is at approximately 9.5%, and the weak supervision bar is at about 3.5%. For Qwen2-72B-VL, the strong supervision bar reaches approximately 15%, and the weak supervision bar is at about 5.5%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis.
